statements.markdown: **Theorem 8.9 (Finite decision procedure).** *Call $n\in[4,L_J/2]$ **bad** if no $M\in[n,2n-2]$ has $\mu_J(M)\le\tfrac{11}{15}$, and set $B(J):=\max(\mathrm{bad}\cup\{3\})$. Then $\mathrm{HalfRung}(J)$ holds iff the greedy orbit for $1/2$ under weights $w_n^{(J)}$ survives every rank from $2$ through $B(J)$. This is a finite exact decision procedure.*
